title: Leadership and vision at AIBS: celebrating 30 years of contributions by Scott Glisson
content: Last year marked Scott Glisson’s 30th anniversary at the American Institute of Biological Sciences (AIBS). On behalf of the Board of Directors, we wish to acknowledge this tremendous achievement by celebrating his many contributions to AIBS and its constituent scientific communities. AIBS has existed for more than 75 years, and for the last three decades, we have been fortunate to count Scott among our ranks. He has advanced the work of AIBS through many different roles: first joining AIBS as a junior staff member, progressing to Director of the Scientific Peer Advisory and Review Services (SPARS) department—serving in that role for 22 years, and since 2018, as our Chief Executive Officer (CEO).
